statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let high := fun m k : ℕ => if k ≤ m then 0 else w k; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun k => (a k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ) * t)); let I := fun (A : Set ℝ) (j : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (A.indicator (fun t => (S n a t)^2 * E (-j * t))) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ n m : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → m ≤ n → ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A → ∀ j : ℝ, ‖I A j n w - I A j n (high m)‖ ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * Real.log (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) * n)

plain_statement.zh: 对自然数 n≥2、m≤n，在 [0,1] 内任意可测区域和任意实解调频率上，删去不超过 m 的素数后，平方指数和积分的复数变化量的模至多为 2 log(4) log(n) √(mn)。
plain_statement.en: For natural n≥2 and m≤n, deleting primes at most m changes the demodulated square integral by at most 2 log(4) log(n) sqrt(mn) in complex norm, uniformly over all measurable regions of the unit interval and real demodulation frequencies.

brief.zh: 将两平方之差分解为两多项式的差与和的乘积。去掉模长为一的相位，对两因子用柯西–施瓦茨和完整单位区间上的 Parseval。分别在 m 和 n 处用切比雪夫 θ 控制系数能量。
brief.en: Factor the difference of squares. Apply Cauchy–Schwarz and full-interval Parseval after taking the modulus of the unit phase. Use Chebyshev theta at m and n to control the two coefficient energies.
